name: What is the design-build process for a home addition with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the design-build process for a home addition with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group's integrated design-build process for a home addition means we handle every aspect from concept to completion under a single point of coordination. It begins with an initial consultation to understand your needs, followed by design planning, including CAD-supported layouts and material selections. Once designs are finalized and permits secured, our team manages all construction, structural integration, interior finishes, and exterior tie-in work. This cohesive approach eliminates the complexities of coordinating multiple contractors and ensures a harmonious project flow, maintaining clear communication throughout.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our design-build process for home additions integrates all phases, from initial consultation and design to permit coordination and construction, under a single team. This ensures a streamlined, managed process from start to finish.
